description.short: Search and read your Kube entities, officers and appointments.
description.full: Connect Microsoft 365 Copilot to your Kube corporate-registry and entity-management platform, published by Kuberno. This agent lets Copilot search and read your organisation's entities, officers, and their appointments, compliance dates and roles — scoped to what your Kube user is permitted to see. It is strictly read-only and honours Kube's per-user access permissions and field-level redaction.
